content.short: OpenFaucet provides free testnet tokens claimed in-browser through proof-of-work mining.
content.description: OpenFaucet hands out free testnet tokens that are claimed by running a small proof-of-work computation in the browser, with no registration. Proof-of-work rate-limits abuse without requiring accounts or social logins. Plasma's official documentation lists it among the faucets for its testnet.
content.meta: OpenFaucet provides free testnet tokens via in-browser proof-of-work, listed for Plasma's testnet.
